name: Slideshow Tilt Spin
description: Full-screen image slideshow where the current slide tilts and shrinks away while the next slides in from below, driven by wheel, touch, drag or arrow buttons.
contents: Full-screen stack of background image slides
Optional scroll hint text with previous and next round arrow buttons
behavior: Wheel, touch and pointer drag navigate between slides through GSAP Observer
Outgoing slide scales down, rotates and moves away while incoming slide rises in with an inner zoom settle
Loops from last slide to first
Navigation is locked while a transition runs
Waits for all images to preload before showing
editableByProps: Images, background and text colors, hint text
Transition duration, easing, scale, offset and rotation
Wheel sensitivity, nav button visibility, size and colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Use different arrow glyphs or icons in the nav buttons
needsCodeEdit.where: the two buttons containing ← and → in the showNavButtons block
the images.map block inside the absolute inset-0 grid

fixed: Fills the viewport height as a full-bleed slider
Captures wheel, touch and pointer input over the whole slideshow while mounted, and the observer is killed on unmount
Slides stay hidden until images are preloaded
